package answer

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

type learningActionLifecycleStub struct {
	repository.LearningActionLifecycleRepository
	createdAction  domain.StudentLearningAction
	reopenedAction domain.StudentLearningAction
	closedAction   domain.StudentLearningAction
	closedEvent    domain.IntegrationEvent
	active         domain.StudentLearningAction
}

func (stub *learningActionLifecycleStub) CreateAnswer(
	_ context.Context,
	answer domain.StudentTaskAnswer,
	_ *int,
	action domain.StudentLearningAction,
) (domain.StudentTaskAnswer, domain.StudentLearningAction, error) {
	answer.Attempt = 1
	action.Cycle = 1
	stub.createdAction = action
	stub.active = action
	return answer, action, nil
}

func (stub *learningActionLifecycleStub) EnsureActive(_ context.Context, action domain.StudentLearningAction) (domain.StudentLearningAction, error) {
	if stub.active.ID != "" {
		return stub.active, nil
	}
	action.Cycle = 1
	stub.active = action
	return action, nil
}

func (stub *learningActionLifecycleStub) GetActiveByAnswer(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentLearningAction, error) {
	if stub.active.ID == "" {
		return domain.StudentLearningAction{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return stub.active, nil
}

func (stub *learningActionLifecycleStub) ReopenAnswer(
	_ context.Context,
	_ domain.StudentTaskAnswer,
	action domain.StudentLearningAction,
) (domain.StudentLearningAction, error) {
	action.Cycle = stub.active.Cycle + 1
	stub.reopenedAction = action
	stub.active = action
	return action, nil
}

func (stub *learningActionLifecycleStub) CloseAnswer(
	_ context.Context,
	_ domain.StudentTaskAnswer,
	action domain.StudentLearningAction,
	event domain.IntegrationEvent,
) error {
	stub.closedAction = action
	stub.closedEvent = event
	return nil
}

type lifecycleAnswerRepositoryStub struct {
	repository.StudentTaskAnswerRepository
	answer domain.StudentTaskAnswer
}

func (stub lifecycleAnswerRepositoryStub) GetByID(context.Context, string) (*domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error) {
	answer := stub.answer
	return &answer, nil
}

func (stub lifecycleAnswerRepositoryStub) Update(context.Context, domain.StudentTaskAnswer) error {
	return nil
}

func TestStartTaskAnswerCreatesDistinctLearningActionWithTargetSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	const (
		studentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
		taskID    = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	)
	lifecycle := &learningActionLifecycleStub{}
	provider := progressionTaskProviderStub{tasks: map[string]*TaskMetadata{
		taskID: {
			ID:            taskID,
			Status:        domain.TaskStatusActive,
			Type:          9,
			ExecutionMode: "NO_RUN",
			LearningTargets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{
				{Type: domain.LearningTargetCapability, Key: "learning.semantic-sequence"},
			},
		},
	}}
	output, err := (StartTaskAnswer{
		TaskProvider:    provider,
		LearningActions: lifecycle,
	}).Handle(context.Background(), StartTaskAnswerInput{StudentID: studentID, TaskID: taskID})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Handle returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if output.LearningActionID == "" || output.LearningActionID == output.AnswerID {
		t.Fatalf("answer_id=%q learning_action_id=%q must be distinct", output.AnswerID, output.LearningActionID)
	}
	if lifecycle.createdAction.ContextType != domain.LearningContextLessonTask || len(lifecycle.createdAction.LearningTargets) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected created action: %+v", lifecycle.createdAction)
	}
	if lifecycle.createdAction.EvidenceClass != domain.LearningEvidenceKnowledgeCheck {
		t.Fatalf("evidence class=%q, want knowledge_check", lifecycle.createdAction.EvidenceClass)
	}
}

func TestActivityAnswerReopenCreatesNewLearningActionCycle(t *testing.T) {
	const (
		studentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
		answerID  = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
		taskID    = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
		actionID  = "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
	)
	lifecycle := &learningActionLifecycleStub{active: domain.StudentLearningAction{ID: actionID, Cycle: 1}}
	provider := progressionTaskProviderStub{tasks: map[string]*TaskMetadata{
		taskID: {
			ID:     taskID,
			Status: domain.TaskStatusActive,
			Type:   3,
			LearningTargets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{
				{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "program.instructions.sequence"},
			},
		},
	}}
	useCase := ActivityAnswer{
		Answers: lifecycleAnswerRepositoryStub{answer: domain.StudentTaskAnswer{
			ID:        answerID,
			StudentID: studentID,
			TaskID:    taskID,
			Status:    domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusFailed,
			StartedAt: time.Now().Add(-time.Hour),
		}},
		TaskProvider:    provider,
		LearningActions: lifecycle,
	}
	if err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), ActivityAnswerInput{AnswerID: answerID, StudentID: studentID}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Handle returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if lifecycle.reopenedAction.ID == "" || lifecycle.reopenedAction.ID == actionID || lifecycle.reopenedAction.StudentTaskAnswerID != answerID {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected reopened action: %+v", lifecycle.reopenedAction)
	}
	if lifecycle.reopenedAction.Cycle != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("reopened cycle=%d, want 2", lifecycle.reopenedAction.Cycle)
	}
	if lifecycle.reopenedAction.EvidenceClass != domain.LearningEvidenceApplication {
		t.Fatalf("evidence class=%q, want application", lifecycle.reopenedAction.EvidenceClass)
	}
}

func TestCloseAnswerLearningActionCreatesDurableClosureEvent(t *testing.T) {
	closedAt := time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	lifecycle := &learningActionLifecycleStub{active: domain.StudentLearningAction{
		ID:                  "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		StudentTaskAnswerID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		StudentID:           "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		TaskID:              "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		Cycle:               1,
		ContextType:         domain.LearningContextLessonTask,
		ContextID:           "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		LearningTargets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{
			{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "program.instructions.sequence"},
		},
		OpenedAt: closedAt.Add(-time.Minute),
	}}
	answer := domain.StudentTaskAnswer{
		ID:        lifecycle.active.StudentTaskAnswerID,
		StudentID: lifecycle.active.StudentID,
		TaskID:    lifecycle.active.TaskID,
		Status:    domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed,
		UpdatedAt: closedAt,
	}
	if err := closeAnswerLearningAction(context.Background(), lifecycle, nil, answer, closedAt); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("closeAnswerLearningAction returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if lifecycle.closedEvent.Subject != domain.SubjectLearningActionClosed || lifecycle.closedEvent.CorrelationID != lifecycle.active.ID {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected closure event: %+v", lifecycle.closedEvent)
	}
	if lifecycle.closedAction.Outcome != domain.LearningActionPassed || lifecycle.closedAction.OutcomePolicyVersion != domain.MasteryPolicyVersion {
		t.Fatalf("outcome snapshot was not assigned: %+v", lifecycle.closedAction)
	}
}

func TestLearningEvidenceClassForTask(t *testing.T) {
	for _, taskType := range []int16{9, 11, 12, 13} {
		class, err := learningEvidenceClassForTask(taskType)
		if err != nil || class != domain.LearningEvidenceKnowledgeCheck {
			t.Fatalf("task type %d class=%q err=%v", taskType, class, err)
		}
	}
	for _, taskType := range []int16{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10} {
		class, err := learningEvidenceClassForTask(taskType)
		if err != nil || class != domain.LearningEvidenceApplication {
			t.Fatalf("task type %d class=%q err=%v", taskType, class, err)
		}
	}
	if _, err := learningEvidenceClassForTask(0); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected unknown task type to fail closed")
	}
}
